english_meaning: A period of time by which something is late or postponed.
gujarati_meaning: નિર્ધારિત સમય કરતાં મોડું થવું — ફ્લાઇટ, ટ્રેન અથવા બીજા વાહન મોડા પડવા.
usage_note: Airlines must compensate passengers for significant delays under EU regulation EC 261/2004.
memory_tip: De (down) + lay (put) → delay = put down/back = late.
examples: The flight had a two-hour delay due to fog.
The delay caused us to miss our connecting flight.
She was frustrated by the unexplained delay.
Passengers received meal vouchers during the delay.

english_meaning: Baggage that an airline has misplaced or failed to deliver to the passenger.
gujarati_meaning: એરલાઇન દ્વારા ખોવાઈ ગયેલ અથવા ડિલિવર ન થયેલ પ્રવાસીનો સામાન.
usage_note: Always keep valuables in carry-on to avoid problems if luggage is lost.
memory_tip: Lost (ખોવાઈ ગયેલ) + luggage (સામાન) = ખોવાઈ ગયેલ સામાન.
examples: He filed a report for lost luggage at the counter.
Her lost luggage arrived two days later.
Lost luggage compensation depends on the airline policy.
Always label your bag to help find lost luggage.

english_meaning: The act of officially calling off a previously planned flight, booking, or event.
gujarati_meaning: અગાઉ ગોઠવાયેલ ફ્લાઇટ, બુકિંગ અથવા ઇવેન્ટ ઔપચારિક રીતે રદ કરવું.
usage_note: Always check the cancellation policy before booking — some are non-refundable.
memory_tip: Cancel (રદ) + ation = cancellation = રદ કરવાની ક્રિયા.
examples: The flight cancellation left hundreds stranded.
We received a refund after the cancellation.
The hotel's cancellation policy required 48 hours notice.
Bad weather led to the cancellation of all departures.

english_meaning: A situation where an airline or hotel accepts more bookings than available seats or rooms.
gujarati_meaning: એવી સ્થિતિ જ્યાં ઉપલબ્ધ સીટ અથવા ઓરડા કરતાં વધારે બુકિંગ સ્વીકારી લેવામાં આવ્યા હોય.
usage_note: If bumped due to overbooking, passengers are entitled to compensation and re-routing.
memory_tip: Over (વધારે) + booking = ક્ષમતા કરતાં વધારે બુક — overbooking.
examples: Due to overbooking, she was bumped to a later flight.
The hotel offered an upgrade after admitting to overbooking.
Airlines practice overbooking to fill seats when passengers no-show.
He received $400 in vouchers due to overbooking.

english_meaning: A thief who steals from people's pockets or bags in crowded places.
gujarati_meaning: ભીડવાળી જગ્યામાં ખિસ્સા અથવા બૅગ ચોરતો ચોર.
usage_note: Tourists are frequent targets; keep valuables in front pockets or money belts.
examples: Her wallet was stolen by a pickpocket on the metro.
Beware of pickpockets in busy tourist areas.
He felt the pickpocket's hand in his jacket.
A money belt protects against pickpockets.

english_meaning: Charged more money than the correct or fair price for a service or product.
gujarati_meaning: ઉચિત કિંમત કરતાં વધારે ચૂકવ્યા — ઠગાઈ ભાવ.
usage_note: Always agree on a price before getting into a taxi or hiring a guide in unfamiliar places.
examples: She felt overcharged at the tourist restaurant.
The taxi driver overcharged us by double the normal fare.
He disputed the overcharged bill at the hotel.
Tourists are often overcharged in busy markets.

english_meaning: A dishonest scheme or trick designed to cheat people, especially tourists, out of money.
gujarati_meaning: નાણા પડાવવા માટેની ઠગ-ચાલ — ખાસ કરીને પ્રવાસીઓ સામે.
usage_note: Research common local scams before visiting a new city to avoid being targeted.
memory_tip: Scam = સ્કૅમ — ઠગ. Remember: if it seems too good to be true, it's a scam.
examples: The fake monk handing out bracelets was a well-known scam.
We nearly fell for a taxi scam at the airport.
Research common scams before visiting a new city.
He was scammed out of $100 by a street vendor.

english_meaning: A feeling of nausea and dizziness caused by the motion of a vehicle, ship, or aircraft.
gujarati_meaning: વાહન, જહાજ અથવા વિમાનની ગતિને કારણે ઉબકા અને ચક્કર આવવા.
usage_note: Anti-nausea medication and looking at the horizon can help reduce travel sickness.
examples: She takes tablets to prevent travel sickness on long bus rides.
Travel sickness made the ferry crossing very unpleasant.
Children are especially prone to travel sickness.
Looking at a fixed point on the horizon reduces travel sickness.

english_meaning: A passport whose validity period has ended, making it no longer accepted for travel.
gujarati_meaning: પાસપોર્ટ — જેની અવધિ પૂરી થઈ ગઈ છે અને હવે મુસાફરી માટે ઉપયોગ ન થઈ શકે.
usage_note: Most countries require a passport valid for at least six months beyond the travel date.
memory_tip: Expired = મુદ્દત પૂરી → expired passport = મુદ્દત પૂરી ગઈ.
examples: She was denied boarding because of an expired passport.
He didn't notice his passport had expired until the check-in.
Always check your passport expiry before booking flights.
Renewing an expired passport can take several weeks.

english_meaning: A situation where a passenger fails to board their scheduled flight before departure.
gujarati_meaning: એવી સ્થિતિ જ્યારે પ્રવાસી નિર્ધારિત ફ્લાઇટ ઊડ્ડયન પહેલાં ચઢી ન શક્યો.
usage_note: If you miss a flight due to an airline error, you are entitled to rebooking or refund.
examples: Traffic caused him to miss his flight.
She missed her flight because the queue at security was too long.
The airline rebooked her after she missed her flight.
A missed flight ruined the first day of the holiday.

english_meaning: The difficulty in communication between people who do not share a common language.
gujarati_meaning: ભાષા ન સમજાવવાને કારણે સંવાદ-સ્થાપનમાં આવતી મુશ્કેલી.
usage_note: Translation apps and learning basic local phrases can significantly reduce the language barrier.
examples: The language barrier made ordering food very difficult.
They used gestures to overcome the language barrier.
A translation app helped bridge the language barrier.
She felt frustrated by the language barrier in rural Japan.

english_meaning: A passport that has been taken without permission by a thief, requiring urgent replacement.
gujarati_meaning: ચોર દ્વારા ચોરી ગયેલ પાસપોર્ટ — જેને તાત્કાલિક બદલવો પડે.
usage_note: Report a stolen passport immediately to local police and the nearest embassy or consulate.
memory_tip: Stolen (ચોરાઈ ગયેલ) + passport (પ્રવાસ-દસ્તાવેજ) = ચોરાઈ ગયેલ પ્રવાસ-દસ્તાવેજ.
examples: Her passport was stolen at the market and she had to visit the embassy.
A stolen passport must be reported to police immediately.
The embassy issued an emergency travel document for the stolen passport.
He kept a photocopy in case his passport was stolen.

english_meaning: The seizure of goods by customs officials because they are prohibited or undeclared.
gujarati_meaning: પ્રતિબંધિત અથવા જાહેર ન કરાયેલ વસ્તુઓ કસ્ટમ અધિકારીઓ દ્વારા જપ્ત કરવી.
usage_note: Prohibited items include certain foods, plant materials, and large sums of undeclared cash.
memory_tip: Customs (ચૅકિંગ) + confiscation (જપ્ત) = સીમા ચૅકિંગ પર જપ્ત.
examples: Her mangoes were subject to customs confiscation at the border.
Customs confiscation of undeclared cash is common.
He lost his expensive camera to customs confiscation.
Always declare goods to avoid customs confiscation.

english_meaning: Left in a place without the means to leave, often due to transport problems or emergencies.
gujarati_meaning: ત્યજી દેવાયેલ — જ્યાં ટ્રાન્સ્પોર્ટ ન મળ્યું અથવા ઇમર્જન્સી ઊભી થઈ.
usage_note: Travel insurance often covers costs when passengers are stranded.
memory_tip: Strand = દરિયા-કિનારો → stranded = beach-like situation — stuck, nowhere to go.
examples: Hundreds of passengers were stranded at the airport overnight.
The snowstorm left us stranded in a small village.
She felt completely stranded without her phone or money.
Stranded tourists received help from the local authorities.

english_meaning: A person designated to be contacted in case of an accident, illness, or emergency while travelling.
gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરી દરમ્યાન અકસ્માત, બીમારી અથવા ઇમર્જન્સી સ્થિતિ વખતે સંપર્ક કરવા માટે નક્કી કરેલ વ્યક્તિ.
usage_note: Always carry an emergency contact's details when travelling internationally.
examples: She listed her mother as the emergency contact on the form.
Always carry your emergency contact's number when abroad.
The hospital called his emergency contact after the accident.
Add your emergency contact details to your passport.

english_meaning: Money returned to a customer after a cancellation, complaint, or overpayment.
gujarati_meaning: રદ-ફ, ફરિયાદ અથવા વધારે ભરણ-ચૂકવ્ છ પછી ગ્રાહકને પૈસા પાછા આપવા.
usage_note: Always keep receipts when travelling to support refund claims if needed.
examples: She received a full refund after the flight was cancelled.
The hotel refused to issue a refund.
He claimed a refund through his travel insurance.
Non-refundable tickets cannot be refunded even if plans change.
